title: Qualify explicit discrete sampling and linear convolution boundary audits
commitMessage: feat: qualify direct signal boundary audits and close M6 W02 C03 S02

contribution.summary: Qualify explicit discrete-sampling and zero-extended linear convolution policies with typed nonpartial refusals and conservative spectral/convolution cancellation heuristics. Recover one compiled missing-API RED with 68 GREEN, preserve 464 scientific tests and four Math regressions, and verify four SHA-equal isolated preview.8 NuGet consumers. Close S02-T2 R/G/V, T2 and S02 only; retain S03, original C03, M6-W02 and M6 unfinished.
contribution.value: Gate direct DFT behind caller acceptance of finite discrete samples, not an alias-free guarantee. Refuse circular convolution and unrequested topologies, and classify strong signed cancellation using conservative 1e-12 ratios, without asserting a numerical error theorem, FFT, resampling, physical units or downstream agent adoption.
debtChanges: Observe one independently compiled missing-public signal-boundary-audit RED before staging the sidecar; a compiler error cannot replace RED evidence.
Recover RED with 68 GREEN tests for explicit discrete sampling, DFT forward/inverse, linear topology, cancellation and finite input refusals.
Require caller acceptance of discrete samples; an array alone cannot establish a Nyquist bandwidth, anti-alias filtering or physical sample interval.
Refuse absent convolution topology and explicitly requested circular topology rather than silently substituting periodic convolution.
Conservatively refuse DFT bins with ratio magnitude/sum-input-magnitudes below 1e-12, including exact zeros from cancellation.
Conservatively refuse signed linear convolution outputs below a 1e-12 output/absolute-term ratio, preserving the direct T1 contract.
Retain 60 S02-T1, 53 S01-T2, 25 S01-T1 and 326 C01/C02 scientific tests plus four Math regression projects and transfer validation.
Pack and SHA-inspect one actual BCL-only local scientific preview.8 archive with net10 DLL and source-free NuGet metadata.
Requalify four separately cached eight-probe pinned preview.8 consumers using only a cleared local feed and identical inspected archive bytes.
Close only S02-T2-R/G/V, S02-T2 and S02; S03, original C03 aggregate, M6-W02 and M6 must remain unfinished.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS096 success, prepare RS097 on M6-W02-C03-S03-T1: bounded uniformly sampled first differences and sliding arithmetic means with explicit positive sample interval, independently compiled RED/GREEN, regressions and source-free NuGet. Keep S03-T2, original C03 and M6 gates open.
